title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepre

translated_title: 构造即一致：合成网络威胁情报（CTI）知识图谱与一致性验证的形式极限
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型合成知识图谱等关系型训练数据时，通常一次只生成一个结构化对象，这虽然保证了每个对象本身的有效性，却使对象之间的关系缺乏依据。我们研究了一种替代性范式——“通过模拟进行生成”：不再直接描述关系型产物，而是模拟产生该产物的过程，并将产物视为这一过程的因果记录。语言模型智能体提出意图，由确定性裁判依据显式世界模型裁决结果，因此只有在关系所对应的事件实际发生时才会输出该关系，从而使一致性成为构造过程的固有属性。我们在 STIX 2.1 标准下针对网络威胁情报知识图谱实例化了该范式，构建了三个引擎，其中包括一个将语言模型遗传算子应用于结构化图基因组的进化引擎，三者共享一个确定性编译器，使格式错误和悬空的输出无法被表示（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“通过模拟进行生成”的新范式：语言模型智能体提出意图、确定性裁判依据显式世界模型裁决事件，使关系仅在对应事件发生时才被输出，从而将网络威胁情报知识图谱的一致性变为构造过程的固有属性，并探讨了一致性验证的形式化极限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "generation by simulation" paradigm in which language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves events against an explicit world model, so relations are emitted only when their events occur—making coherence a property of construction for CTI knowledge graphs—while also examining the formal limits of coherence validation.
